key_points: FAA confirmed 737 MAX software glitch does not pose in-flight safety issue, reducing immediate operational/safety concerns.
Boeing CEO indicated 737 production remains unstable, which remains a near-term operational overhang.
Boeing secured a $20B Navy contract for next-gen fighter jet, supporting defense/eros revenue visibility.
Analyst projects 737 MAX 10 certification by year-end with potential 36% upside, signaling improving momentum.
Union deal supports labor stability while FAA review remains a key near-term catalyst for recovery.
